hero.eyebrow: Open source · runs locally · no account
hero.title: DM YOUR CODEBASE
hero.subtitle: CodeDM connects WhatsApp, Instagram and Telegram to coding agents running on this Mac — DM your codebase like it's any other chat. Nothing leaves your machine.

channels.title: Channels become terminal agents
channels.description: Pair WhatsApp, Instagram or Telegram once. Every message routes straight to a coding agent running in a terminal session on your Mac — Claude Code, Codex, whichever you point it at.

issues.title: Issues, written from a message
issues.description: "The coupon field is broken on mobile" gets classified into a tracked issue, scoped to a workspace folder, and handed to an agent. No board, no ticket forms — just the chat you already sent.

human.title: Human-in-the-loop stops
human.description: Agents pause and ping you the moment they need a call. Open the session, decide, resume — or leave a thread autonomous so replies ship without review. You stay in control of every merge.

local.title: Local-first, always
local.description: No account, no cloud, no telemetry. Agents run against project folders on your own machine and everything — messages, sessions, artifacts — stays local. Open source, MIT licensed.

cta.title: PUT YOUR CONTACTS TO WORK
cta.subtitle: Connect a channel, point at a project folder, attach a thread. Your first coding agent is three steps away.
cta.note: macOS · open source · runs entirely on your Mac
